description:
WASDI is a cloud platform for Earth Observation (EO).
We help EO developers turn their algorithm into an operative service in the cloud, with just a drag & drop of their code. We call this Develop at Home, Deploy to the Cloud. Once their application is deployed, it can be executed from the web and, if the owners wish to, they can publish it in a marketplace, where end users can run them to solve their business needs. 
We currently support ENVI IDL, Python (both ananconda and pip), C#, JavaScript, Java and Octave. Moreover, WASDI also allows the execution of SNAP workflows (also known as SNAP graphs).
WASDI runs federated instances across multiple clouds and DIASes. For the user, this means exploiting data and services from different providers is very easy, without the burden of managing cloud technologies and protocols.
entityDescription:
WASDI SARL is a Luxembourgish startup aiming at democratising Earth Observation (EO). The company is a joint venture between Fadeout Software in Italy and the Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST).
The company runs the WASDI cloud platform that helps EO experts develop algorithms and turn them into applications in the cloud. Additionally, the platform allows them to publish their applications in a marketplace to reach end users. With a unified interface, seamless access to data, and online tools, WASDI allows professionals to concentrate on work that matters rather than grappling with IT-related difficulties.
On top of this enabling horizontal technology, the WASDI team develops vertical applications. In collaboration with world-class partners, the team developed several applications used in international initiatives in different areas (e.g. natural hazards, environmental monitoring, and urban areas). Vertical applications built with WASDI include the monitoring and mapping of floods, water bodies, drought risk, urban areas, fires & burned areas, impact assessment, oil spills, and air quality. These applications enabled innovative services such as parametric insurance.
Recently, WASDI launched its latest product, RISE - Remote Imaging Support for Emergencies, developed as part of the WFP’s Humanitarian Innovation Accelerator. RISE is a fully automated EO web platform designed to monitor areas vulnerable to natural hazards by leveraging remote sensing technology to provide historical data and near real-time monitoring of floods, drought risk, human settlements, and their impacts. The system is also built for future expansion to support the monitoring of additional hazards and models, such as forest fires, air quality, landslides, and deforestation.

entityDescription:
Proambiente is a no-profit public-private consortium, including CNR (National Research Council) as reference partner, the University of Ferrara and 9 SMEs located in the EmiliaRomagna Region. Its mission is to foster innovation and promote Technology Transfer to enterprises in the overall field of environment. The activity of Proambiente focuses on environmental monitoring and remediation in the air, water and soil compartment, with the additional efforts on preservation of cultural heritage. These efforts are carried out through the development of advanced and innovative services, as well as through the construction of new sensors, tools and platforms. 
Proambiente mostly works for companies that need non-standard and innovative solutions for:
- environmental impact reduction and increase in productivity,
- environmental monitoring in air, water using advanced and innovative techniques,
- new instruments and sensors development for environmental monitoring and contaminants reduction.
Proambiente gathers the experience of many decades of research activities, considering the participation of renown researchers and the availability of labs, instruments and know-how of the CNR personnel.
The staff of Proambiente represents a highly skilled and dedicated team made up of 8 industrial researchers, with a large interdisciplinary expertise (electronics, physics, chemistry, marine geology, agronomy and computer science).

entityName: DLR - RESPONSIVE SPACE CLUSTER COMPETENCE CENTER RSC³ (DLR RS)
entityDescription:
The use of navigation systems, bookings in stock trading to the split second, the almost centimeter-accurate control of huge container ships - all this would be inconceivable without space-based services.
This is all the more true for the military sector and applications in the field of security: Space-based systems are essential for the capabilities of the German Armed Forces, the “Bundeswehr”, and are generally essential in the security sector. The Bundeswehr's concept for the space domain states:
The security and functionality of a modern information society depend on unhindered access to space-based information and communication channels. The same applies to the operational capability and readiness of the Bundeswehr, which depends on space-based applications and satellite systems to fulfill its missions. Space is to be regarded as an operational domain.
To protect, repair, augment or further expand the critical infrastructure Space, the technical capability is required to launch new satellites with a wide variety of payloads into orbit and bring them into service within a few days or even hours. In the international military context, this is referred to as "Responsive Space Capability".
The Responsive Space Cluster Competence Center RSC³ at the DLR site in Trauen was established with the overall objective to setup the required technology base for a Responsive Space Capability and conducting technology demonstrations in a timely manner. For this purpose, technologies in the entire architecture, consisting of space, ground, launch and mission segments, are investigated and further developed. In line with the cluster concept, the competence center works in close cooperation with existing DLR institutes and facilities as well as with end users and industry.

Located in Hamburg, the private and independent Hamburg Ship Model Basin - HSVA - is a service and consulting company for clients in the maritime industry worldwide.
Our products contribute to a greener, more sustainable usage of marine environments. We help reducing emissions from shipping and we increase safety in marine transportation.
We are partners to our clients for the development of innovative, tailor-made solutions in shipping and offshore operations. For experimental investigations we are offering world class testing facilities.
Its leading role in national and international research programs makes HSVA a most competent partner in science and services in the field of maritime hydrodynamics, maritime aerodynamics and arctic technology as well as associated disciplines.

description: Solar Foods produces protein using air and electricity. Solar Foods revolutionises food production with a method that is not dependent on agriculture, the weather, or the climate. BELCOM Digital a.s. is a completely independent partner for its customers which has a direct interest in the success of the customer’s project and not deliveries of hardware or software or other ICT components.
We have experience and knowledge gained from implementation of several projects in the given field, on the basis of which we are able to provide services of this nature very effectively. To this end, we are able to use the basis of the standard processes, standards, analyses and approaches we have created. 
A no less important aspect is the ability to also manage extensive projects and to steer these towards achievement of the required objectives within the planned schedule and whilst adhering to the planned financial resources. This element of our work is also fully supported by the fact that responsible and fully qualified employees who go to make up a professional and stable team participate in implementation of our services.
The economic results of BELCOM Digital achieve stable year on year growth. Over the course of more than ten years of activity on the Czech market, BELCOM Digital has achieved very significant successes, has established and reinforced its position and gained a wide portfolio of satisfied customers. 
 
BELCOM Digital a.s. (has at its disposal a certified management system for the field of audit and consultancy services in the field of management consultancy, project management, IT and communication technologies, system integration, security and certification:
 
· for the Quality Management System, in compliance with EN ISO 9001:2016
· for the Information Security System, in compliance with ISO/IEC 27001:2014
· for the Service Management System, in compliance with ISO/IEC 20000-1:2019
 
 
BELCOM Digital a.s.:
· also holds security clearance for familiarisation with classified information with the classification level “Classified” and for provision, creation and storage of classified information with the classification level “Confidential”. 
· also holds confirmation from the Czech branch of the international certification company TŰV Nord for a Project Quality Management System in compliance with ČSN EN ISO 10006:2004.

entityDescription:
LAND Italia Srl is an international landscape consultancy with offices in Italy, Switzerland and Germany and with high-profile projects throughout Europe, Canada, Middle East. 
Andreas Kipar and a team of more than 100 landscape architects, architects, urban planners, agronomists, engineers & researchers have been transforming regions, cities and places since 1990.LAND’s consulting and design practice aims to improve people’s well-being through the implementation of climate-positive solutions and participative processes that lead to sustainable development.We advise public and private clients on how to innovate with nature by applying international policies and promoting collaborative planning procedures. Together with our clients and our extensive network of partners, we unlock the potential of our societies’ green transition.
Main projects include: Green Rays strategy, Porta Nuova and the re-development of the former EXPO site MIND in Milan; Urban Open Space Strategy and Krupp Park, comprising ThyssenKrupp HQ, and the Freiheit Emscher in Essen; Ruhr Regional Green Infrastructure Strategy; the renaturation of the Airolo valley and Cassarate River Park in Switzerland; Zuglo District Budapest; Moscow Smart City in Rublyovo-Arkhangelskoye; Saint-Laurent biodiversity Corridor in Montreal; Urubah Park in Riyad and the Dubai EXPO 2020 in the UAE; the German Pavilion at the EXPO Beijing 2019; the research and innovation projects UNaLab and T-Factor funded by the European Commission.LAND’s work has been recognized through over 17 prestigious international awards, amongst them Premio Mercurio, MIPIM, Wan Awards, Biennale Pisa, Passive and Low Energy Architecture Award (PLEA).

LAND Research Lab� (LRL) is the research&innovation think tank of LAND Group on emerging trends and technologies for landscape development. The Lab aims to identify collaborative procedures and data-driven methodologies to make cities and rural areas more liveable, climate-proof and resource-efficient by reconnecting people with nature.The Lab provides consultancy on urban and territorial transformation processes applying international sustainability guidelines to local ecosystem and communities, fostering regenerative projects and renaturation measures.Special services provided are design and assessment of nature-based solutions, green infrastructure planning, sustainability strategies, participative public space ideation and cooperation within European research networks. Among the main consultancy products developed so far, deserve to be mentioned Digital Landscape, Adaptive Design, and LIM landscape information modelling�.LRL is partner of the H2020-funded projects UNaLab and T-Factor; moreover we joined “Italian Architects Declare Climate and Biodiversity Emergency” initiative, signed the Manifersto for EU Covid-19 Research and Nature-Based Solutions Cooperation Manifesto, and are member of NetworkNature platform, the European Task-Force on NBS Impact and YAC teaching panel.

entityName: Scuola Sant'Anna - Istituto di Intelligenza Meccanica (IIM)
entityDescription:
The Institute of Mechanical Intelligence (IIM) was established in May 2021 bringing together the two research groups of Scuola Superiore Sant’Anna working on Perceptual Robotics (PERCRO) and Advanced Optical Sensors, with the aim of developing hardware and software components of artificial systems and for studying their interactions with humans. 
IIM research stems from the vision that the emerging pervasiveness of the integration between physical and digital systems will soon call upon humans to share in their everyday life complex digital and physical environments with artificial entities, like robots, androids and virtual humans. The need to interact with these entities requires that research into their design and development be accompanied by a multidisciplinary study of their interaction with human beings. 
In this framework, the Institute of Mechanical Intelligence, based on the notion that the intelligence of an artificial system derives from the integration of hardware and software aspects, carries out interdisciplinary research, innovation activities and technology transfer into five areas: Human Robot Interaction, Intelligent Autonomous Systems, Extended Reality, Robotic Mechanisms and Materials, Optical Fiber Sensors and Integrated Photonic Subsystems.
